claims.claim: Nokia's Q2 2026 AI & Cloud customer sales grew 105% year over year and AI & Cloud order intake reached EUR 2.8 billion; management said supply remains the main industry constraint.

risks.risk: AI/cloud order growth can be constrained by optical-component supply and order-to-revenue timing.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of triple-digit AI & Cloud growth beyond current capacity expansion remains unproven.

claims.claim: Q2 net sales grew 9% constant-currency, comparable operating margin expanded 70 bps to 9.0%, and operational full-year outlook remained unchanged despite a technical presentation revision.

risks.risk: Reported operating margin was negative due to accelerated restructuring, creating a meaningful comparable-versus-reported earnings distinction.

contradictions.contradiction: Comparable operating margin improved to 9.0% while reported operating margin declined to -1.0% because restructuring accelerated; underwriting should preserve both views.

unknowns.unknown: Restructuring benefits and cash costs need longitudinal validation.
